data.text: Release rehearsal for 0.8.0 (2026-09-30): the prompt hook and kadence search, asked 'how do we release kadence?', return DEC-13, KAD-52 and KAD-46; DOC-64 'Releasing kadence', the one record that answers it, is not in the top 5. 'release' does not match 'releasing' without stemming, same family as 'pilot' vs 'pilots' (09-29). The hook's first real question in this session missed the obvious document.
